time.en: not given | Cook: not given | Total: 45 min

en.v: Hummus can be refrigerated for up to 5 days.

sk.v: Hummus môžete uchovávať v chladničke až 5 dní.

en.t: 59 ml water
2 tbsp (30 ml) lemon juice
60 g tahini, stirred well
2 tbsp (30 ml) extra-virgin olive oil
1 (425 g) can chickpeas, rinsed
1 garlic clove, minced
1/2 tsp (3 g) salt
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) ground cumin
Pinch cayenne
1. Combine water and lemon juice in bowl; set aside. Whisk tahini and oil together in second bowl.

2. Process chickpeas, garlic, salt, cumin, and cayenne in food processor until coarsely ground, about 15 seconds, scraping down bowl as needed. With food processor running, slowly add water mixture until incorporated and process until smooth, about 1 minute. With food processor still running, slowly add tahini mixture until incorporated and process until creamy, about 15 seconds, scraping down bowl as needed.
3. Transfer hummus to serving bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let sit until flavors meld, at least 30 minutes. (Hummus can be refrigerated for up to 5 days.) Serve.

1. V miske spojíme vodu a citrónovú šťavu a odložíme. V druhej miske vymiešame metličkou tahini s olejom.

2. Cícer, cesnak, soľ, rascu (kmín) a kajenské korenie rozmixujeme v kuchynskom robote nahrubo, asi 15 sekúnd; podľa potreby zoškrabujeme steny nádoby. Za chodu robota pomaly prilievame vodu s citrónovou šťavou, kým sa nezapracuje, a mixujeme dohladka, asi 1 minútu. Stále za chodu robota pomaly pridávame zmes tahini, kým sa nezapracuje, a mixujeme do krémova, asi 15 sekúnd; podľa potreby zoškrabujeme steny nádoby.
3. Hummus preložíme do servírovacej misky, prikryjeme potravinovou fóliou a necháme postáť, kým sa chute nespoja, aspoň 30 minút. (Hummus vydrží v chladničke až 5 dní.) Podávame.

cat.en: Let the hummus sit, covered, for at least 30 minutes before serving so the flavours meld.
cat.sk: Hummus nechajte pred podávaním aspoň 30 minút prikrytý odstáť, aby sa chute prepojili.

tip.en: Rinse jarred roasted red peppers and dry them thoroughly with paper towels before blending them into the hummus.
tip.sk: Pečenú červenú papriku z pohára pred rozmixovaním do hummusu opláchnite a dôkladne osušte papierovými utierkami.

src: Serious Eats — J. Kenji López-Alt — "The Best Baba Ganoush"

time.en: 30 min | Cook: 30 min | Total: 60 min

en.v: Grill, rimmed baking sheet, fine-mesh strainer, paring knife, salad spinner

sk.v: Gril, plech s okrajom, jemné sitko, malý kuchynský nôž, odstreďovač na šalát

en.v: The baba ganoush can be made ahead of time and stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to four days. Let it come back to room temperature before serving.

sk.v: Baba ganoush môžeme pripraviť vopred a uchovávať v uzatvárateľnej nádobe v chladničke až štyri dni. Pred podávaním ho necháme zohriať na izbovú teplotu.

en.t: 3 medium Italian eggplants (about 900 g total), pricked all over with a fork
2 tbsp (30 ml) juice from 1 lemon, plus more as desired
3 medium cloves garlic, minced
3 tbsp (45 ml) tahini
80 ml extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for serving
59 ml chopped fresh parsley leaves
Kosher salt

sk.t: 3 stredné talianske baklažány (spolu asi 900 g), dookola popichané vidličkou
2 PL (30 ml) šťava z 1 citróna, podľa chuti aj viac
3 stredné strúčiky cesnaku, nadrobno nasekané
3 PL (45 ml) tahini (sezamová pasta)
80 ml extra panenský olivový olej, trochu navyše na podávanie
59 ml lístky čerstvej petržlenovej vňate, nasekané
hrubozrnná soľ

en.t: 1. If Using a Grill (recommended): Preheat a gas or charcoal grill to medium heat and place eggplants directly over heat source. Cook, turning occasionally with tongs, until eggplants are completely tender and well charred on all sides, 30 to 40 minutes. Wrap with foil and let rest 15 minutes. Continue to step 3.

2. If Using the Broiler: Adjust rack to 15 cm below broiler element and preheat broiler to high. Place eggplants on a foil-lined rimmed baking sheet and prick all over with a fork. Broil, turning occasionally, until charred on all sides and completely tender, about 30 minutes (timing may vary depending on broiler strength). Eggplants should be very, very tender when cooked; if eggplant is not fully tender once skin is charred all over, switch oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C) and roast until fully tender (a toothpick or skewer inserted near stem and bottom ends should not meet any resistance). Remove from oven and gather up foil, crimping it around eggplants to form a sealed package. Let eggplants rest for 15 minutes. Continue to step 3.

3. Open foil package. Working with one eggplant at a time, use a sharp paring knife to slit each eggplant open lengthwise. Carefully scoop out soft flesh with a large spoon and transfer to a fine-mesh strainer set in a large bowl. Once all eggplant is scooped, pick out any stray bits of skin and blackened flesh and discard.

4. Transfer eggplant to a salad spinner, distributing it evenly around the perimeter. Spin gently until all excess moisture is extracted. Discard all drippings, wipe out large bowl, and return eggplant to bowl.

5. Add lemon juice and garlic to eggplant and stir vigorously with a fork until eggplant breaks down into a rough paste, about 1 1/2 minutes. Stirring constantly and vigorously, add tahini, followed by the olive oil in a thin, steady stream. The mixture should become pale and creamy. Stir in parsley and season to taste with salt, plus more lemon juice if desired.
6. Transfer to a serving bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and serve with warm pita bread or vegetables for dipping.

sk.t: 1. Na grile (odporúčame): plynový alebo drevouhoľný gril rozohrejeme na stredný žiar a baklažány položíme priamo nad zdroj tepla. Grilujeme a občas obraciame kliešťami, kým baklažány nie sú úplne mäkké a zo všetkých strán dobre pripálené, 30 až 40 minút. Zabalíme do alobalu a necháme 15 minút odpočívať. Pokračujeme krokom 3.

2. Pod grilom v rúre: rošt nastavíme 15 cm pod grilovacie teleso a gril rozohrejeme na najvyšší stupeň. Baklažány položíme na plech s okrajom vystlaný alobalom a celé ich popicháme vidličkou. Grilujeme a občas obraciame, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán pripálené a úplne mäkké, asi 30 minút (čas sa môže líšiť podľa výkonu grilu). Upečené baklažány musia byť veľmi, veľmi mäkké; ak baklažán po pripálení šupky ešte nie je úplne mäkký, rúru prepneme na 220 °C (teplovzdušnú na 200 °C) a pečieme, kým nezmäkne úplne (špáradlo alebo ihla zapichnutá pri stopke a na spodnom konci by nemali naraziť na žiadny odpor). Vyberieme z rúry, alobal zhrnieme a okolo baklažánov ho pozahýbame, aby vznikol uzavretý balíček. Baklažány necháme 15 minút odpočívať. Pokračujeme krokom 3.

3. Balíček z alobalu otvoríme. Spracúvame po jednom baklažáne: ostrým nožíkom ho pozdĺžne prerežeme. Mäkkú dužinu opatrne vyberieme veľkou lyžicou a preložíme do jemného sitka nad veľkou misou. Keď máme vybratú všetku dužinu, vyberieme z nej zatúlané kúsky šupky a sčernenej dužiny a vyhodíme ich.

4. Baklažán preložíme do odstredivky na šalát a rovnomerne ho rozložíme po obvode. Jemne odstreďujeme, kým neodstránime všetku prebytočnú vlhkosť. Všetku tekutinu vylejeme, veľkú misu vytrieme a baklažán do nej vrátime.

5. K baklažánu pridáme citrónovú šťavu a cesnak a energicky miešame vidličkou, kým sa baklažán nerozpadne na hrubú pastu, asi 1 1/2 minúty. Za stáleho energického miešania pridáme tahini a potom tenkým, rovnomerným prúdom olivový olej. Zmes by mala zosvetlieť a byť krémová. Vmiešame petržlenovú vňať a podľa chuti dochutíme soľou a podľa potreby ďalšou citrónovou šťavou.
6. Preložíme do servírovacej misky, pokvapkáme olivovým olejom a podávame s teplou pitou alebo so zeleninou na namáčanie.

cat.en: Char the aubergines over high heat for smokiness, then spin the flesh in a salad spinner to remove excess moisture for a creamier dip.

src: Serious Eats — J. Kenji López-Alt — "Classic Guacamole Recipe"

time.en: 10 min | Cook: not given | Total: 10 min

en.v: Molcajete, mortar and pestle, or food processor

sk.v: Molcajete (mexický kamenný mažiar), mažiar s tĺčikom, alebo kuchynský robot

en.t: 1 small yellow onion, roughly chopped
1 serrano chile, roughly chopped
120 ml picked cilantro leaves, finely chopped, divided
2 tsp (6 g) kosher salt
4 ripe avocados
2 tbsp (30 ml) juice from 2 limes

sk.t: 1 malá žltá cibuľa, nahrubo nasekaná
1 paprička serrano, nahrubo nasekaná
120 ml obrané lístky koriandrovej vňate, nadrobno nasekané, rozdelené na časti
2 ČL (6 g) hrubozrnná soľ
4 zrelé avokáda
2 PL (30 ml) šťava z 2 limetiek

en.t: 1. Place onion, chile, half of cilantro leaves, and a large pinch of salt in a molcajete or mortar and pestle. Pound into a fine paste. Alternatively, combine onion, chile, half of cilantro, salt, and half of lime juice in a food processor or blender and process, scraping down sides as necessary, until smooth paste is formed.

2. Split each avocado in half, discard pits, and spoon out flesh into the molcajete or mortar and pestle (if large enough), or combine with the onion-chile purée in a medium mixing bowl. Roughly mash with the pestle or a stiff whisk.
3. Stir in remaining cilantro leaves, then season with lime juice and salt to taste. Serve immediately with warm tortilla chips or as desired.

sk.t: 1. Cibuľu, čili papričku, polovicu lístkov koriandra a veľkú štipku soli dáme do molcajete alebo mažiara. Roztlčieme na jemnú pastu. Prípadne cibuľu, čili, polovicu koriandra, soľ a polovicu limetkovej šťavy rozmixujeme v kuchynskom robote alebo mixéri na hladkú pastu a podľa potreby zoškrabujeme steny.

2. Každé avokádo rozpolíme, kôstky vyhodíme a dužinu vyberieme lyžicou do molcajete alebo mažiara (ak je dosť veľký), prípadne ju v strednej mise spojíme s cibuľovo-čili pyré. Nahrubo roztlačíme tĺčikom alebo pevnou metličkou.
3. Vmiešame zvyšné lístky koriandra a podľa chuti dochutíme limetkovou šťavou a soľou. Hneď podávame s teplými tortilla čipsami alebo podľa chuti.

en.t: 113 g, plus 2 tbsp (21 g) unroasted walnuts, divided
43 g panko breadcrumbs

71 g Middle Eastern jarred mild red pepper paste or spread
60 ml pomegranate molasses
2 tsp (10 ml) fresh lemon juice
2 3/4 tsp (8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt use half as much by volume
1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml) ground coriander
1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml) ground cumin
1 tsp (5 ml) ground Aleppo pepper
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) ground allspice
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) black pepper
2 tbsp (30 ml) pomegranate seeds (28 g), optional
Mint sprig or 5 to 7 picked mint leaves for garnish, optional
Pita bread for serving
1. In the bowl of a food processor, process 115 g walnuts until very finely chopped (do not process into a paste), about 30 seconds. Transfer to a large bowl and set aside.
2. Add panko to the now-empty food processor bowl and process until fine, about 45 seconds. Transfer to the same bowl with the walnuts; set aside.

3. Line a fine-mesh strainer with cheesecloth and place it over a separate large bowl. Process peppers until very finely chopped, scraping sides of bowl as needed, about 1 1/2 minutes. Transfer to prepared strainer. Process onions in now-empty food processor bowl until fine, scraping sides of bowl as needed, about 1 minute. Add onions to strainer with processed peppers. Allow mixture to strain, occasionally pressing it with a rubber spatula and discarding liquid as it accumulates, until mixture is thickened and most of liquid has drained, about 30 minutes. Once strained, wrap the cheesecloth around the mixture and squeeze firmly over strainer until only a light stream of liquid is released.

4. Transfer drained pepper-onion mixture to bowl with walnuts. Add olive oil, red pepper paste, pomegranate molasses, lemon juice, salt, coriander, cumin, Aleppo pepper, allspice, and black pepper. Mix well to combine. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow the flavors to meld.

5. Transfer muhammara to a serving dish and drizzle generously with olive oil. Cut the remaining 2 tbsp (30 ml) walnuts in half lengthwise. Top muhammara decoratively with walnuts and pomegranate seeds, if using. Garnish with a mint sprig or leaves for decoration, if using. Serve with pita.

1. V nádobe kuchynského robota nasekáme 115 g vlašských orechov veľmi najemno (nemixujeme na pastu), asi 30 sekúnd. Preložíme do veľkej misy a odložíme.
2. Do vyprázdnenej nádoby robota dáme strúhanku panko a zomelieme najemno, asi 45 sekúnd. Preložíme do misy k orechom a odložíme.

3. Jemné sitko vystelieme gázou a položíme ho nad ďalšiu veľkú misu. Papriky nasekáme v robote veľmi najemno, asi 1 1/2 minúty; podľa potreby zoškrabujeme steny nádoby. Preložíme do pripraveného sitka. Vo vyprázdnenej nádobe robota nasekáme najemno cibuľu, asi 1 minútu; podľa potreby zoškrabujeme steny. Cibuľu pridáme do sitka k paprikám. Zmes necháme odkvapkať, občas ju pritlačíme gumenou stierkou a nazbieranú tekutinu priebežne vylievame, kým zmes nezhustne a väčšina tekutiny neodtečie, asi 30 minút. Potom gázu okolo zmesi zabalíme a nad sitkom pevne vytlačíme, kým nevyteká už len slabý prúdik tekutiny.

4. Odkvapkanú paprikovo-cibuľovú zmes preložíme do misy s orechmi. Pridáme olivový olej, pastu z červenej papriky, granátovú melasu, citrónovú šťavu, soľ, koriander, rascu (kmín), papriku Aleppo, nové korenie a čierne korenie. Dobre premiešame. Prikryjeme a aspoň 1 hodinu chladíme, aby sa chute spojili.

5. Muhammaru preložíme na servírovací tanier a bohato pokvapkáme olivovým olejom. Zvyšné 2 PL (30 ml) orechov pozdĺžne rozpolíme. Muhammaru ozdobne posypeme orechmi a, ak ich používame, zrniečkami granátového jablka. Ak ju používame, ozdobíme vetvičkou alebo lístkami mäty. Podávame s pitou.

1. Line a fine meshed strainer with 3 basket-style paper coffee filters or a double layer of cheesecloth. Set the strainer over a deep container (there should be enough room for a generous 235 ml of liquid to drain without touching the strainer). Spoon the yogurt into the strainer, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until the yogurt has released about 235 ml of liquid and has a creamy, cream cheese-like texture, 10 to 12 hours (it can stay in the strainer for up to 2 days).
2. Transfer the yogurt cheese to a clean container, discarding the drained liquid. The cheese will keep for up to 1 week in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Grease a 1890 ml baking dish with cooking spray; set aside.

c.t: Skordalia should be strongly garlicky (about 6 cloves); use 4 or 5 for a milder one. The source prefers lemon juice with white wine vinegar, or the vinegar alone for its sharper acidity.
Skordalia má byť výrazne cesnaková (asi 6 strúčikov); na jemnejšiu použite 4 alebo 5. Zdroj odporúča citrónovú šťavu s bielym vínnym octom, alebo samotný ocot pre ostrejšiu kyslosť.

en.t: 2 medium russet potatoes (about 450 g), peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes
Kosher salt
85 g whole blanched almonds
4 to 6 medium cloves garlic
90 ml white wine vinegar and/or fresh lemon juice (from about 2 lemons)
180 ml extra-virgin olive oil
Minced flat-leaf parsley, for garnish
Warmed pita and/or bread, for serving

1. Preheat oven to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). Set cubed potatoes in a colander and rinse under cold water until water runs clear. Transfer to a large saucepan and cover with cold water by at least 5 cm. Season water with salt until it is salty like tears. Bring water to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until a knife easily pierces potatoes with no resistance, 10 to 15 minutes. Drain potatoes in colander, then rinse with hot running water for 30 seconds.
2. Meanwhile, in a food processor, combine almonds, garlic, 2 tbsp (30 ml) cold water, and wine vinegar and/or lemon juice. Process until garlic and almonds are reduced to a paste. Season with salt.
3. Spread potatoes in an even layer on a rimmed baking sheet and transfer to oven until excess moisture has evaporated and surface of potatoes is dry and looks chalky, about 6 minutes.
4. Using a potato ricer or a food mill with the finest disk, mash potatoes into a large mixing bowl. Alternatively, thoroughly mash potatoes with a potato masher in a large mixing bowl.

5. Stir in olive oil and almond-garlic mixture until thoroughly incorporated. If skordalia looks like it's breaking slightly (i.e., if the oil does not fully incorporate to form a homogeneous mixture), stir in more cold water, 1 tbsp (15 ml) at a time, beating well, until mixture is emulsified. Season with salt, then garnish with parsley and serve immediately with warm pita or bread, or chill until ready to serve.

1. Add 1 tray of ice cubes to a large bowl and fill with water. Fill a large pot with 2.5 cm of water. Place steamer insert inside, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Add eggs to steamer basket, cover, and continue cooking over high heat for 12 minutes. Immediately place eggs in bowl of ice water and allow to cool for at least 15 minutes before peeling under cool running water. Slice each egg in half lengthwise.

2. Place all yolks in the bowl of a food processor. Select 16 of the best-looking egg white halves and set aside; reserve remaining 8 for another use. Add mayonnaise, mustard, 1/2 tbsp (7 ml) vinegar, and hot sauce to food processor and process until smooth, scraping down sides of bowl as necessary.

3. With machine running, slowly drizzle in 2 tbsp (30 ml) olive oil. Season mixture to taste with salt and remaining vinegar (if desired). Transfer to a zipper-lock bag. Filling and egg white halves can be stored in the refrigerator up to overnight before eggs are filled and served.

4. Cut off a corner of zipper-lock bag and pipe filling mixture into egg whites, overstuffing each. Drizzle with remaining olive oil and sprinkle with black pepper, chives, crushed red pepper or paprika, and sea salt. Serve immediately.

en.t: 280 g all-purpose flour, such as King Arthur, plus extra for shaping and rolling out the pastry
1 1/2 tsp (4.5 g) kosher salt
1 tsp (5 ml) caraway seeds, lightly cracked (optional)
60 ml neutral oil, such as grapeseed
80 ml plus 45 ml chilled water, divided
680 g medium russet potatoes, cleaned and scrubbed
Kosher salt
60 g frozen peas, thawed and drained
2 tbsp (30 ml) neutral oil, such as grapeseed
2 tsp (10 ml) ground coriander
1 tsp (5 ml) cumin seeds
1 tsp (5 ml) ground turmeric
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) garam masala
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) Kashmiri chile powder
1 tsp (5 ml) ground black pepper
1 to 2 fresh green chiles such as jalapeño or serrano, stemmed and finely chopped
One 5 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and minced
15 g tightly packed chopped fresh cilantro leaves and tender stems
Maggi’s Hot and Sweet Ketchup or mint, cilantro, or tamarind chutney, for serving

1. For the Pastry Dough: In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine flour, salt, and caraway seeds (if using) and mix by hand to evenly disperse the ingredients. Drizzle oil over the flour and rub it in with your fingertips. Once the fat is completely incorporated into the flour, the mixture will take on a crumbly appearance.

2. Set bowl on stand mixer, and fit with dough hook attachment. Add 80 ml of chilled water and mix on low speed until dough comes together in a ball, adding extra water 1 tbsp (15 ml) at a time as needed to form a cohesive dough; it should not be unduly sticky or wet, nor should it be dry and crumbly. Stop the mixer, scrape down sides of bowl with a rubber spatula, then continue to knead on low speed until dough is smooth and slightly elastic to the touch, pliable and resistant to tearing, but not tough, about 5 minutes. Alternatively, the dough can be prepared by hand.

3. The dough should weigh about 455 g. Wrap dough in plastic, and let it rest at cool room temperature, around 21 °C, until dough is pliable, and jumps back when gently pressed, at least 30 minutes, or up to 4 hours. For a longer rest, it can be refrigerated for up to 24 hours, then brought to cool room temperature, around 21 °C, before use.

4. For the Potato and Pea Filling: Place potatoes in a medium saucepan, cover with enough water so they are fully submerged, and add 1 tsp (4 g) salt. Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat to a simmer, cover with a lid, and cook until potatoes are tender, offering little resistance when poked with a paring knife, about 20 minutes. Drain potatoes and allow to cool until easy to handle; wipe out saucepan and return to stovetop.

5. Once cool, peel and discard skins, and transfer potatoes to a large bowl. Using a fork, mash potatoes until flaky and no visible chunks remain, about 1 minute. The texture should not resemble smooth mashed potatoes. Add peas and stir gently to combine.

6. In now-empty saucepan, heat oil over medium heat until shimmering. Add coriander, cumin, turmeric, and garam masala, and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30 to 45 seconds. Remove from heat and add chile powder.

7. Pour contents of saucepan over potato mixture. Add black pepper, green chiles, ginger, cilantro, and 1 tsp (4 g) salt. Using a rubber spatula, fold until well combined. Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt if needed. If making samosas right away, let filling cool to room temperature, between 20 and 25 °C, before using. Alternatively, transfer filling to an airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use. Allow to come to room temperature before stuffing into dough.

8. For Filling, Frying and Serving the Samosas: Divide dough into 10 equal portions by weight, and shape each into a ball over a cool and dry surface using minimal flour. Transfer dough balls to a lightly floured baking sheet and cover loosely with plastic wrap. Fill a small bowl with water.
9. Working with one ball of dough at a time, roll out dough to form an 18 cm circle. Using a sharp knife, cut the circle in half; return to the baking sheet. Repeat with remaining dough balls.

10. Working with one semicircle at a time, wet a fingertip in the bowl of water and dab halfway down the straight edge, and then fold the wet end over the dry side, pressing gently to seal. This will form a triangular pocket. Hold the pocket open like a little waffle cone, and gently spoon in 40 g (about 3 tbsp) potato filling. Dab the tip of a finger in water and moisten the inner flap of dough, then fold it over the filling, and press gently to seal it against the dough on the other side, then gently pinch each corner of the samosa to ensure all three points are well sealed.

11. Transfer samosa to a lightly floured baking sheet and cover loosely with plastic wrap. Repeat the process with remaining dough and filling. Prior to frying, if the dough seems to have warmed up too much and feels too soft, briefly refrigerate samosas until dough is just firm. (If allowed to chill completely, the interiors may not properly cook through.)

12. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 95 °C (fan 75 °C). Set a wire rack in a rimmed baking sheet, and set aside. In a large Dutch oven, add enough oil to reach a depth of at least 5 cm, leaving a few cm to spare at the top. Heat oil to 171 °C over medium-high heat. When oil comes to temperature, brush any excess flour from the samosas. Fry samosas, 5 at a time, turning them occasionally, until golden brown and puffed on all sides, 10 to 12 minutes (the oil temperature will drop significantly once the samosas are added; adjust heat to maintain temperature between 165 and 171 °C). Avoid overcrowding the pot, as too many samosas will reduce the temperature of the oil and make the finished pastry soggy. Using a spider or slotted spoon, transfer cooked samosas to prepared baking sheet, and transfer to oven to keep warm.

13. Skim any browned bits from oil and discard. Return oil to 171 °C, and repeat with remaining samosas. Serve warm with either Maggi’s Hot and Sweet ketchup or chutney, such as mint, cilantro, or tamarind.

c.t: 1. For the Pastry Dough: In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine flour, salt, and caraway seeds (if using) and mix by hand to evenly disperse the ingredients. Drizzle oil over the flour and rub it in with your fingertips. Once the fat is completely incorporated into the flour, the mixture will take on a crumbly appearance.

2. Set bowl on stand mixer, and fit with dough hook attachment. Add 80 ml of chilled water and mix on low speed until dough comes together in a ball, adding extra water 1 tbsp (15 ml) at a time as needed to form a cohesive dough; it should not be unduly sticky or wet, nor should it be dry and crumbly. Stop the mixer, scrape down sides of bowl with a rubber spatula, then continue to knead on low speed until dough is smooth and slightly elastic to the touch, pliable and resistant to tearing, but not tough, about 5 minutes. Alternatively, the dough can be prepared by hand.

3. The dough should weigh about 455 g. Wrap dough in plastic, and let it rest at cool room temperature, around 21 °C, until dough is pliable, and jumps back when gently pressed, at least 30 minutes, or up to 4 hours. For a longer rest, it can be refrigerated for up to 24 hours, then brought to cool room temperature, around 21 °C, before use.

4. For the Potato and Pea Filling: Place potatoes in a medium saucepan, cover with enough water so they are fully submerged, and add 1 tsp (4 g) salt. Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat to a simmer, cover with a lid, and cook until potatoes are tender, offering little resistance when poked with a paring knife, about 20 minutes. Drain potatoes and allow to cool until easy to handle; wipe out saucepan and return to stovetop.

5. Once cool, peel and discard skins, and transfer potatoes to a large bowl. Using a fork, mash potatoes until flaky and no visible chunks remain, about 1 minute. The texture should not resemble smooth mashed potatoes. Add peas and stir gently to combine.

6. In now-empty saucepan, heat oil over medium heat until shimmering. Add coriander, cumin, turmeric, and garam masala, and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30 to 45 seconds. Remove from heat and add chile powder.

7. Pour contents of saucepan over potato mixture. Add black pepper, green chiles, ginger, cilantro, and 1 tsp (4 g) salt. Using a rubber spatula, fold until well combined. Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt if needed. If making samosas right away, let filling cool to room temperature, between 20 and 25 °C, before using. Alternatively, transfer filling to an airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use. Allow to come to room temperature before stuffing into dough.

8. For Filling, Frying and Serving the Samosas: Divide dough into 10 equal portions by weight, and shape each into a ball over a cool and dry surface using minimal flour. Transfer dough balls to a lightly floured baking sheet and cover loosely with plastic wrap. Fill a small bowl with water.
9. Working with one ball of dough at a time, roll out dough to form an 18 cm circle. Using a sharp knife, cut the circle in half; return to the baking sheet. Repeat with remaining dough balls.

10. Working with one semicircle at a time, wet a fingertip in the bowl of water and dab halfway down the straight edge, and then fold the wet end over the dry side, pressing gently to seal. This will form a triangular pocket. Hold the pocket open like a little waffle cone, and gently spoon in 40 g (about 3 tbsp) potato filling. Dab the tip of a finger in water and moisten the inner flap of dough, then fold it over the filling, and press gently to seal it against the dough on the other side, then gently pinch each corner of the samosa to ensure all three points are well sealed.

11. Transfer samosa to a lightly floured baking sheet and cover loosely with plastic wrap. Repeat the process with remaining dough and filling. Prior to frying, if the dough seems to have warmed up too much and feels too soft, briefly refrigerate samosas until dough is just firm. (If allowed to chill completely, the interiors may not properly cook through.)

12. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 95 °C (fan 75 °C). Set a wire rack in a rimmed baking sheet, and set aside. In a large Dutch oven, add enough oil to reach a depth of at least 5 cm, leaving a few cm to spare at the top. Heat oil to 171 °C over medium-high heat. When oil comes to temperature, brush any excess flour from the samosas. Fry samosas, 5 at a time, turning them occasionally, until golden brown and puffed on all sides, 10 to 12 minutes (the oil temperature will drop significantly once the samosas are added; adjust heat to maintain temperature between 165 and 171 °C). Avoid overcrowding the pot, as too many samosas will reduce the temperature of the oil and make the finished pastry soggy. Using a spider or slotted spoon, transfer cooked samosas to prepared baking sheet, and transfer to oven to keep warm.

13. Skim any browned bits from oil and discard. Return oil to 171 °C, and repeat with remaining samosas. Serve warm with either Maggi’s Hot and Sweet ketchup or chutney, such as mint, cilantro, or tamarind.

1. Cesto: v mise stolového robota zmiešame múku, soľ a rascu (ak ju používame) a rukou premiešame, aby sa suroviny rovnomerne rozložili. Múku pokvapkáme olejom a končekmi prstov ho do nej vtierame. Keď je tuk úplne zapracovaný do múky, zmes bude vyzerať drobivo.

2. Misu nasadíme na stolový robot a nasadíme hák na cesto. Pridáme 80 ml vychladenej vody a na nízkej rýchlosti miesime, kým sa cesto nespojí do gule; podľa potreby pridávame vodu po 1 PL (15 ml), aby vzniklo súdržné cesto; nemá byť prehnane lepkavé ani mokré, ale ani suché a drobivé. Robot zastavíme, gumenou stierkou zoškrabeme steny misy a na nízkej rýchlosti miesime ďalej, kým cesto nie je hladké a na dotyk mierne pružné, vláčne a odolné proti trhaniu, ale nie tuhé, asi 5 minút. Cesto môžeme pripraviť aj ručne.

3. Cesto by malo vážiť asi 455 g. Zabalíme ho do fólie a necháme odpočívať pri chladnejšej izbovej teplote, okolo 21 °C, kým cesto nie je vláčne a po jemnom zatlačení sa nevracia späť, aspoň 30 minút alebo až 4 hodiny. Na dlhšie odpočívanie ho môžeme dať do chladničky až na 24 hodín a pred použitím ho necháme zohriať na chladnejšiu izbovú teplotu, okolo 21 °C.

4. Zemiakovo-hrášková plnka: zemiaky dáme do stredného hrnca, zalejeme toľkou vodou, aby boli úplne ponorené, a pridáme 1 ČL (4 g) soli. Na silnom ohni privedieme do varu, stlmíme na mierny var, prikryjeme pokrievkou a varíme, kým zemiaky nie sú mäkké a pri prepichnutí nožíkom kladú len malý odpor, asi 20 minút. Zemiaky scedíme a necháme vychladnúť, kým sa s nimi nedá ľahko manipulovať; hrniec vytrieme a vrátime na sporák.

5. Vychladnuté zemiaky olúpeme, šupky vyhodíme a zemiaky preložíme do veľkej misy. Vidličkou ich roztlačíme, kým nie sú rozsypčivé a nezostanú v nich viditeľné kúsky, asi 1 minútu. Konzistencia nemá pripomínať hladkú zemiakovú kašu. Pridáme hrášok a jemne premiešame.

6. Vo vyprázdnenom hrnci zohrejeme na strednom ohni olej, kým sa nezačne vlniť. Pridáme koriander, rascu (kmín), kurkumu a garam masalu a za stáleho miešania opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, 30 až 45 sekúnd. Odstavíme z ohňa a pridáme mletú čili papričku.

7. Obsah hrnca vylejeme na zemiakovú zmes. Pridáme čierne korenie, zelené čili papričky, zázvor, koriandrovú vňať a 1 ČL (4 g) soli. Gumenou stierkou dobre premiešame. Ochutnáme a podľa potreby dosolíme. Ak robíme samosy hneď, plnku necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu, medzi 20 a 25 °C, až potom ju použijeme. Prípadne plnku preložíme do uzavretej nádoby a do použitia chladíme. Pred plnením cesta ju necháme zohriať na izbovú teplotu.

8. Plnenie, vyprážanie a podávanie samos: cesto rozdelíme podľa hmotnosti na 10 rovnakých dielov a na chladnej, suchej ploche s minimom múky z každého vytvarujeme guľku. Guľky cesta preložíme na zľahka pomúčený plech a voľne prikryjeme potravinovou fóliou. Malú misku naplníme vodou.
9. Spracúvame po jednej guľke: cesto rozvaľkáme na kruh s priemerom 18 cm. Ostrým nožom kruh rozpolíme; vrátime na plech. Zopakujeme so zvyšnými guľkami.

10. Spracúvame po jednom polkruhu: koniec prsta namočíme do misky s vodou a navlhčíme rovný okraj do polovice, potom navlhčený koniec preložíme cez suchú stranu a jemne pritlačíme, aby sa spojil. Vznikne trojuholníkový vrecúško. Vrecúško podržíme otvorené ako malý kornútok na zmrzlinu a lyžicou doň jemne naplníme 40 g (asi 3 PL) zemiakovej plnky. Koniec prsta namočíme do vody, navlhčíme vnútornú chlopňu cesta, preložíme ju cez plnku a jemne pritlačíme k cestu na druhej strane, potom jemne stlačíme každý roh samosy, aby boli všetky tri cípy dobre uzavreté.

11. Samosu preložíme na zľahka pomúčený plech a voľne prikryjeme potravinovou fóliou. Postup zopakujeme so zvyšným cestom a plnkou. Ak sa nám pred vyprážaním zdá, že sa cesto príliš zohrialo a je príliš mäkké, samosy krátko vychladíme v chladničke, kým cesto práve nestuhne. (Ak by úplne vychladli, vnútro by sa nemuselo dostatočne prepiecť.)

12. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 95 °C (teplovzdušnú na 75 °C). Do plechu s okrajom vložíme mriežku a odložíme. Do veľkého liatinového hrnca nalejeme toľko oleja, aby siahal do výšky aspoň 5 cm a navrchu zostalo niekoľko cm voľného miesta. Na stredne silnom ohni olej rozohrejeme na 171 °C. Keď olej dosiahne teplotu, zo samos oprášime prebytočnú múku. Samosy vyprážame po 5 kusoch a občas ich obraciame, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán zlatistohnedé a nafúknuté, 10 až 12 minút (po vložení samos teplota oleja výrazne klesne; ohňom ju udržiavame medzi 165 a 171 °C). Hrniec nepreplňujeme, pretože priveľa samos zníži teplotu oleja a cesto zostane rozmoknuté. Sieťkou alebo dierovanou lyžicou preložíme hotové samosy na pripravený plech a dáme ich do rúry, aby zostali teplé.

13. Z oleja zoberieme všetky zhnednuté zvyšky a vyhodíme ich. Olej znova rozohrejeme na 171 °C a zopakujeme so zvyšnými samosami. Podávame teplé s kečupom Maggi Hot and Sweet alebo s čatní, napríklad mätovým, koriandrovým či tamarindovým.

en.t: 2 × 375 g packets all-butter puff pastry
olive oil for frying; 1 onion, finely diced; 2 garlic cloves, finely chopped
pinch ground cumin; pinch ground cinnamon; ½ tsp (2.5 ml) paprika
300 g minced beef
4 tbsp (48 g) pitted green olives, chopped; 1 tsp (4 g) dried oregano; ½ tsp (2 g) dried chilli flakes; pinch of sugar
2 hard-boiled eggs, finely chopped; 1 large egg, beaten; sea salt and black pepper

Chimichurri: bunch flat-leaf parsley; 3 garlic cloves; 1 tbsp (15 ml) chopped fresh oregano (or 1 tsp (5 ml) dried); 1 tsp (5 ml) dried chilli flakes; 1 tbsp (15 ml) red wine vinegar; 1 tbsp (15 ml) lemon juice; 5 tbsp (74 ml) olive oil
1. Roll the pastry 3 mm thick, cut 18 discs of 11 cm, cover and chill.

2. Sweat onion and garlic in a little oil about 5 minutes; add cumin, cinnamon and paprika. Add beef, season and brown about 5 minutes. Mix in olives, oregano, chilli, sugar and chopped eggs; adjust seasoning and cool.
3. Spoon about 1 tbsp (15 ml) onto each disc, egg-wash half the border, fold to a half-moon, seal and crimp. Chill 20 minutes.
4. Preheat oven to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). Make a steam hole in each, brush with egg and bake 18–20 minutes until golden.
5. Chimichurri: roughly chop parsley, garlic and fresh oregano in a small processor; add the rest and blitz briefly; season.
6. Cool on a rack; serve warm or cold with the chimichurri.

src: Serious Eats — Kate Williams — "Chicken Croquettes (Croquetas de Pollo) From 'Spain'"

time.en: 15 min | Cook: 50 min | Total: 215 min

en.t: 1 tbsp (15 ml) extra-virgin olive oil
340 g boneless, skinless chicken breast
Salt
110 g butter, cut into pieces
1 medium onion, very finely chopped
720 ml whole milk
Freshly ground black pepper
Pinch freshly grated nutmeg
125 g all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
2 eggs
140 g fine breadcrumbs
Sunflower oil or mild olive oil for frying

1. In a skillet or sauté pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Season the chicken with salt and sauté until cooked through, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a platter to cool. Cut the chicken into pieces and grind with a food processor.
2. In a clean skillet or sauté pan, melt the butter over medium heat and add the onion. Cook over medium-low heat, until soft and transparent but not yet browned, about 12 minutes.
3. Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, bring the milk to a simmer; season with salt, pepper, and the nutmeg. Reduce the heat, cover the pan, and keep hot.

4. Sift the flour into the skillet over the onion and cook, stirring constantly, for about 2 minutes. It should be a compact and just-moist ball. Spread out the ball in the pan and begin slowly stirring in the hot milk until the mixture is creamy and not too sticky when touched, about 5 minutes. Reduce the heat to low and fold in the ground chicken. Cook, gently stirring, for 2 minutes. The mixture should be spongy and can be touched without sticking to your finger.
5. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl to cool. Once cool, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for several hours until chilled. (This will make forming the croquettes easier.)
6. On a flat work surface dusted with flour, form croquettes into 5–6.5 cm long cylinders about 2.5 cm in diameter. Lightly roll in flour.
7. Break the eggs in a bowl and thoroughly whisk. Place the breadcrumbs in a second bowl.
8. Dip the croquettes in the egg and roll in breadcrumbs to completely cover.
9. In a skillet or sauté pan, heat at least 2 cm of sunflower oil over medium-high heat. Reduce the heat to medium-low.

10. Working in small batches that don’t crowd the pan, fry the croquettes, turning frequently, until they are golden on the outside and hot and creamy at the center, about 2 minutes. Gently transfer them to absorbent paper towels to drain off excess oil. Serve hot.

1. Na panvici alebo v sotéze zohrejeme na strednom ohni olivový olej. Kuracie mäso osolíme a opekáme, kým nie je prepečené, asi 10 minút. Preložíme na tanier a necháme vychladnúť. Mäso nakrájame na kúsky a zomelieme v kuchynskom robote.
2. Na čistej panvici alebo v sotéze roztopíme na strednom ohni maslo a pridáme cibuľu. Dusíme na miernom až strednom ohni, kým nie je mäkká a sklovitá, ale ešte nezhnedla, asi 12 minút.
3. Medzitým v strednom hrnci privedieme mlieko k miernemu varu; osolíme, okoreníme a pridáme muškátový oriešok. Oheň stlmíme, hrniec prikryjeme a mlieko udržiavame horúce.

4. Na cibuľu v panvici preosejeme múku a za stáleho miešania ju opekáme asi 2 minúty. Mala by vzniknúť kompaktná, len mierne vlhká guľa. Guľu v panvici rozotrieme a začneme pomaly vmiešavať horúce mlieko, kým zmes nie je krémová a na dotyk nie príliš lepkavá, asi 5 minút. Oheň stlmíme na mierny a zľahka vmiešame zomleté kuracie mäso. Za jemného miešania varíme 2 minúty. Zmes by mala byť pružná a pri dotyku by sa nemala lepiť na prst.
5. Zmes preložíme do veľkej misy a necháme vychladnúť. Vychladnutú prikryjeme potravinovou fóliou a niekoľko hodín chladíme v chladničke, kým dobre nevychladne. (Krokety sa potom ľahšie tvarujú.)
6. Na rovnej pracovnej ploche posypanej múkou vytvarujeme krokety na valčeky dlhé 5–6,5 cm s priemerom asi 2,5 cm. Zľahka ich obalíme v múke.
7. Vajcia rozbijeme do misky a dôkladne rozšľaháme. Do druhej misky nasypeme strúhanku.
8. Krokety namočíme do vajca a obalíme v strúhanke, aby boli úplne pokryté.
9. Na panvici alebo v sotéze zohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni aspoň 2 cm slnečnicového oleja. Oheň stlmíme na mierny až stredný.

10. Krokety vyprážame po malých dávkach, aby neboli v panvici natlačené, a často ich obraciame, kým nie sú zvonka zlatisté a vnútri horúce a krémové, asi 2 minúty. Opatrne ich preložíme na papierové utierky, aby odkvapkal prebytočný olej. Podávame horúce.

en.v: 2840 ml saucier or saucepan, stand mixer, rimmed baking sheet, parchment paper, pastry bag and tip

sk.v: Rajnica s guľatým dnom (saucier) alebo rajnica 2840 ml, stojanový mixér, plech s okrajom, papier na pečenie, cukrárske vrecko so špičkou

To refresh refrigerated or frozen gougères, transfer to a baking sheet and reheat in a 175 °C (fan 155 °C) oven until crisp, about 5 minutes

Pred podávaním vychladené alebo zmrazené gougères preložíme na plech a ohrejeme v rúre pri 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C), kým nie sú chrumkavé, asi 5 minút

c.t: Water or milk both work; water is enough given the rich cheese, while milk browns more deeply. For even puffs, trace 4 cm circles on baking paper as a template and turn it over onto the baking sheet.
Poslúži voda aj mlieko; pri bohatom syre stačí voda, mlieko zas viac zhnedne. Pre rovnaké veľkosti si na papier na pečenie obkreslite kruhy 4 cm a papier otočte naopak na plech.

en.t: 235 g water or milk
6 tbsp (85 g) unsalted butter, cut into roughly 1.5 cm cubes
1/2 tsp (2 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt use half as much by volume or the same weight
128 g all-purpose flour, sifted
4 large eggs
115 g finely grated Gruyère cheese, plus more for sprinkling
Pinch freshly grated nutmeg
Pinch freshly ground black pepper
Egg wash made from 1 large egg whisked with 1 tbsp (15 ml) water; or nonstick cooking spray
1. In a 2840 ml stainless-steel saucier or saucepan, combine water (or milk), butter, and salt.

2. Set over high heat and cook until liquid comes to a rolling boil and butter has fully melted, about 2 minutes (the small butter cubes should be fully melted just about at the same time the liquid hits a strong boil).
3. Remove from heat and add flour. Using a wooden spoon or stiff silicone spatula, thoroughly mix in flour until no lumps remain (make sure to hunt down and smash out any stubborn ones).

4. Return saucepan to medium-high heat and cook, stirring very frequently, until dough registers 80 °C on an instant-read thermometer; if you don't have a thermometer, other signs the dough is ready include a thin starchy film forming all over the inside of the saucier and the dough pulling together into a cohesive mass.

5. To use a stand mixer: Transfer dough to a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment and beat at medium speed until dough registers 63 °C on an instant-read thermometer (you need the dough cool enough that it doesn't cook the eggs when they're added).

6. Add eggs one at a time, making sure each is fully beaten into the dough before adding the next; it can help to start the mixer at medium-low speed for the first egg and then increase the speed to medium once the choux batter begins to develop.
7. Scrape down sides of mixer bowl, then add Gruyère, nutmeg, and black pepper. Mix at medium speed just until cheese and seasonings are fully incorporated, about 10 seconds.

8. To finish dough by hand: Let dough cool in saucepan, stirring frequently, until it registers 63 °C on an instant-read thermometer. Add eggs 1 at a time, stirring well between additions until each egg is fully incorporated before adding the next, until a smooth, shiny paste forms. Mix in cheese, nutmeg, and black pepper until well combined.
9. Scrape gougères batter into a pastry bag fitted with 1.5 cm pastry tip. At this point, the batter can be held in the sealed pastry bag at room temperature for up to 2 hours.

10. To Bake: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. If desired, pipe a dab of gougères batter under each of the 4 corners of the parchment to secure it in place.
11. Pipe gougères batter onto parchment paper in 4 cm mounds. You should have enough batter to pipe 20 gougères.
12. Using a moistened finger, gently press down any pointy tips on the mounds to smooth them out.

13. Using a pastry brush, gently brush a light layer of egg wash on each mound, being careful not to let excess egg wash drip down onto the parchment. Alternatively, spray mounds lightly with nonstick cooking spray.
14. Sprinkle a pinch of grated Gruyère on top of each mound, pushing down very gently to ensure it adheres to the surface.

15. Bake until gougères are puffed, deeply golden brown, and feel hollow when lifted, 20 to 25 minutes. Turn off oven, crack the door open, and let stand for 30 minutes to dry and fully set the crust.
16. Gougères are best served while still warm; if they cool down too much before serving, briefly reheat in an oven heated to 175 °C (fan 155 °C) before serving.

1. V nerezovom kastróle alebo hrnci s objemom 2840 ml spojíme vodu (alebo mlieko), maslo a soľ.

2. Postavíme na silný oheň a zohrievame, kým tekutina prudko nezovrie a maslo sa úplne neroztopí, asi 2 minúty (malé kocky masla by sa mali úplne roztopiť zhruba v tom istom čase, keď tekutina silno zovrie).
3. Odstavíme z ohňa a pridáme múku. Drevenou varechou alebo pevnou silikónovou stierkou múku dôkladne vmiešame, kým nezostanú žiadne hrudky (vyhľadáme a roztlačíme aj tie najtvrdohlavejšie).

4. Kastról vrátime na stredne silný oheň a za veľmi častého miešania zohrievame, kým cesto na vpichovom teplomere neukáže 80 °C; ak teplomer nemáme, ďalšími znakmi pripraveného cesta sú tenký škrobový povlak na celej vnútornej stene kastróla a cesto, ktoré sa spojí do súdržnej hmoty.

5. So stolovým robotom: cesto preložíme do stolového robota s plochým miešadlom a na strednej rýchlosti miešame, kým cesto na vpichovom teplomere neukáže 63 °C (cesto musí byť dosť vychladnuté, aby vajcia po pridaní neuvarilo).

6. Vajcia pridávame po jednom a každé pred pridaním ďalšieho úplne zapracujeme do cesta; pomôže, ak pri prvom vajci začneme na nízkej až strednej rýchlosti a keď sa odpaľované cesto začne vytvárať, zvýšime rýchlosť na strednú.
7. Zoškrabeme steny misy a pridáme Gruyère, muškátový oriešok a čierne korenie. Na strednej rýchlosti miešame len dovtedy, kým sa syr a koreniny úplne nezapracujú, asi 10 sekúnd.

8. Dokončenie cesta ručne: cesto necháme v kastróle chladnúť za častého miešania, kým na vpichovom teplomere neukáže 63 °C. Vajcia pridávame po 1 a medzi jednotlivými prídavkami dobre miešame, kým sa každé vajce úplne nezapracuje, až kým nevznikne hladká, lesklá hmota. Vmiešame syr, muškátový oriešok a čierne korenie, kým sa dobre nespoja.
9. Cesto na gougères zoškrabeme do cukrárskeho vrecka s 1,5 cm hladkou špičkou. V tejto fáze môžeme cesto nechať v uzavretom vrecku pri izbovej teplote až 2 hodiny.

10. Pečenie: rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 205 °C (teplovzdušnú na 185 °C). Plech s okrajom vystelieme papierom na pečenie. Podľa potreby nastriekame pod každý zo 4 rohov papiera kvapku cesta, aby papier držal na mieste.
11. Na papier nastriekame cesto na kôpky s priemerom 4 cm. Cesta by malo stačiť na 20 gougères.
12. Navlhčeným prstom jemne pritlačíme špicaté vŕšky kôpok, aby sa vyhladili.
13. Cukrárskym štetcom jemne potrieme každú kôpku tenkou vrstvou rozšľahaného vajca a dávame pozor, aby prebytočné vajce nestekalo na papier. Prípadne kôpky zľahka postriekame olejom v spreji.
14. Na každú kôpku posypeme štipku strúhaného Gruyère a veľmi jemne ho pritlačíme, aby sa prichytil na povrch.

15. Pečieme, kým gougères nie sú nafúknuté, sýto zlatistohnedé a po zdvihnutí sa nezdajú duté, 20 až 25 minút. Rúru vypneme, dvierka pootvoríme a necháme 30 minút postáť, aby kôrka vyschla a úplne stuhla.
16. Gougères sú najlepšie podávané ešte teplé; ak pred podávaním príliš vychladnú, krátko ich zohrejeme v rúre rozohriatej na 175 °C (teplovzdušnej na 155 °C) a potom podávame.

en.t: 468 g bread flour
2 tsp (8 g) sugar
½ tsp (1.5 g) instant or rapid-rise yeast
315 ml ice water
1 tbsp (15 ml) extra-virgin olive oil
1½ tsp (9 g) table salt
3 tbsp (44 ml) extra-virgin olive oil, divided
455 g ground lamb
1 onion, chopped fine
3 garlic cloves, minced
1 tsp (6 g) table salt
¼ tsp (1.2 ml) ground cinnamon
¼ tsp (1.2 ml) ground nutmeg
¼ tsp (1.2 ml) pepper
⅛ tsp (0.6 ml) cayenne pepper
47 g pine nuts, toasted
2 tbsp (30 ml) tahini
1 tbsp (15 ml) pomegranate molasses

1. For the dough: Pulse flour, sugar, and yeast in food processor until combined, about 5 pulses. With processor running, slowly add ice water and process until dough is just combined and no dry flour remains, about 10 seconds. Let dough rest for 10 minutes.

2. Add oil and salt to dough and process until dough forms satiny, sticky ball that clears sides of bowl, 30 to 60 seconds. Transfer dough to lightly oiled counter and knead by hand to form smooth, round ball, about 30 seconds. Place dough seam side down in lightly greased large bowl or container, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 24 hours or up to 3 days.

3. For the filling: Heat 1 tbsp (15 ml) oil in 30 cm nonstick skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Add lamb and onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until lamb is no longer pink and onion is lightly browned, 10 to 12 minutes. Stir in garlic, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, pepper, and cayenne and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Off heat, stir in pine nuts, tahini, and pomegranate molasses. Transfer to bowl and let cool completely, about 30 minutes. (Filling can be refrigerated for up to 24 hours.)

4. Press down on dough to deflate. Transfer dough to clean counter and divide into 24 equal portions (about 35 g each). Working with 1 dough portion at a time and keeping remaining dough portions covered with plastic wrap, cup dough with your palm and roll against counter into smooth, tight ball. Space dough balls 2.5 cm apart on counter, cover loosely with greased plastic, and let rest for 1½ hours.

5. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 230 °C (fan 210 °C). Line 2 rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper. Working with 1 dough ball at a time, generously coat with flour and place on well-floured counter (keeping remaining balls covered). Press and roll into 10 cm circle, then place 1 tbsp (7.5 g) lamb filling in center of circle. Grasping edges of dough at 4 and 8 o’clock, lift dough around filling and pinch tightly to seal. Grasp top of dough (12 o’clock) and lift around filling to meet at center seam, pinching tightly to seal. Pinch edges of dough where they meet to seal seam (dough should be rough triangle shape). Transfer to prepared sheet, evenly spacing 12 fatayer over each prepared sheet.

6. Brush fatayer with remaining 2 tbsp (30 ml) oil. Bake, 1 sheet at a time, until deep golden brown, 12 to 15 minutes. Transfer sheets to wire rack and let cool for 15 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.

1. Cesto: múku, cukor a droždie premiešame v kuchynskom robote niekoľkými pulzmi, asi 5 pulzmi. Za chodu robota pomaly prilejeme ľadovú vodu a mixujeme, len kým sa cesto nespojí a nezostane suchá múka, asi 10 sekúnd. Cesto necháme 10 minút odpočívať.

2. K cestu pridáme olej a soľ a mixujeme, kým cesto nevytvorí saténovú, lepkavú guľu, ktorá sa odlepí od stien nádoby, 30 až 60 sekúnd. Cesto preložíme na zľahka naolejovanú pracovnú plochu a ručne ho miesime na hladkú okrúhlu guľu, asi 30 sekúnd. Cesto vložíme spojom nadol do zľahka vymastenej veľkej misy alebo nádoby, pevne prikryjeme potravinovou fóliou a necháme v chladničke aspoň 24 hodín alebo až 3 dni.

3. Plnka: v nepriľnavej panvici s priemerom 30 cm zohrejeme na strednom ohni 1¾ ČL (9 ml) oleja, kým sa nezačne vlniť. Pridáme jahňacie mäso a cibuľu a za občasného miešania opekáme, kým mäso nie je ružové a cibuľa zľahka nezhnedne, 10 až 12 minút. Vmiešame cesnak, soľ, škoricu, muškátový oriešok, korenie a kajenské korenie a opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 30 sekúnd. Mimo ohňa vmiešame píniové oriešky, tahini a granátovú melasu. Preložíme do misy a necháme úplne vychladnúť, asi 30 minút. (Plnka vydrží v chladničke až 24 hodín.)

4. Cesto stlačíme, aby spľasklo. Preložíme ho na čistú pracovnú plochu a rozdelíme na 24 rovnakých dielov (každý asi 35 g). Spracúvame po 1 diele, zvyšné diely necháme prikryté potravinovou fóliou: cesto prikryjeme dlaňou a krúživým pohybom o pracovnú plochu z neho vytvarujeme hladkú, pevnú guľku. Guľky rozložíme na pracovnej ploche 2,5 cm od seba, voľne prikryjeme vymastenou fóliou a necháme 1½ hodiny odpočívať.

5. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 230 °C (teplovzdušnú na 210 °C). Dva plechy s okrajom vystelieme papierom na pečenie. Spracúvame po 1 guľke: bohato ju obalíme v múke a položíme na dobre pomúčenú pracovnú plochu (zvyšné guľky necháme prikryté). Pritlačíme a rozvaľkáme na kruh s priemerom 10 cm, potom doprostred kruhu dáme 1 PL (7,5 g) jahňacej plnky. Uchopíme okraje cesta v miestach, kde by na ciferníku bola štvorka a osmička, zdvihneme cesto okolo plnky a pevne stlačíme, aby sa spojilo. Uchopíme vrchnú časť cesta (na ciferníku dvanástka), zdvihneme ju okolo plnky k stredovému spoju a pevne stlačíme. Stlačíme okraje cesta v mieste, kde sa stretávajú, aby sa spoj uzavrel (cesto by malo mať tvar približného trojuholníka). Preložíme na pripravený plech, na každý plech rovnomerne rozložíme 12 fatayer.

6. Fatayer potrieme zvyšnými 1¼ PL (18 ml) oleja. Pečieme po 1 plechu, kým nie sú sýto zlatistohnedé, 12 až 15 minút. Plechy preložíme na mriežku a necháme 15 minút chladnúť. Podávame teplé alebo pri izbovej teplote.

en.t: 360 g all-purpose flour
200 g sugar
4 tsp (13 g) fast-acting yeast
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) freshly grated nutmeg
1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract
1890 ml vegetable or other neutral oil, for frying
1. In a large bowl, thoroughly whisk together flour, sugar, yeast, and nutmeg, about 1 minute. In a small bowl, combine vanilla extract with 475 ml lukewarm water.

2. In the center of the flour mixture, make a well about 10 cm wide. Pour vanilla water into well, and, using a wooden spoon, gradually stir flour into the water until a thick, sticky batter has formed and no lumps remain, about 5 minutes (batter should have the same consistency as cake batter with a few bubbles). Cover bowl loosely with plastic wrap or a clean, damp kitchen towel, and let sit at warm room temperature (24 °C) until roughly doubled in size, about 45 minutes.

3. Line a rimmed baking sheet with paper towels. In a wok or large Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat to 165 °C. Using a 1-tbsp cookie scoop, dip scoop in hot oil, then scoop a 1-tbsp portion of batter and carefully add to oil, dropping portion from as close to the oil’s surface as possible to minimize splashing. (Alternatively, using two spoons dipped in the hot oil, scoop roughly 1-tbsp of batter onto first spoon, and, using second spoon, gently form into a round shape, then carefully release into hot oil). Working quickly, repeat process until wok is full but not overcrowded. Fry puff puff, using a spider or slotted spoon to turn them as they cook, until puffed and golden brown on all sides, about 6 minutes. Transfer puff puff to prepared baking sheet.

4. Return oil to 165 °C and repeat frying with remaining batter, continuing to work in batches. Transfer puff puff to a serving bowl and serve hot, warm, or at room temperature. Puff puff can be eaten on its own, tossed in spiced sugar, or with a dip.

1. Vo veľkej mise dôkladne vymiešame metličkou múku, cukor, droždie a muškátový oriešok, asi 1 minútu. V malej miske zmiešame vanilkový extrakt so 475 ml vlažnej vody.

2. V strede múčnej zmesi urobíme jamku so šírkou asi 10 cm. Do jamky vlejeme vanilkovú vodu a drevenou varechou postupne vmiešavame múku do vody, kým nevznikne husté, lepkavé cesto bez hrudiek, asi 5 minút (cesto by malo mať konzistenciu cesta na koláč s niekoľkými bublinkami). Misu voľne prikryjeme potravinovou fóliou alebo čistou vlhkou kuchynskou utierkou a necháme postáť v teplej miestnosti (24 °C), kým zhruba nezdvojnásobí objem, asi 45 minút.

3. Plech s okrajom vystelieme papierovými utierkami. Vo woku alebo veľkom liatinovom hrnci rozohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni olej na 165 °C. Naberačku na sušienky s objemom 1 PL ponoríme do horúceho oleja, naberieme ňou 1 PL cesta a opatrne ju vložíme do oleja; cesto spúšťame čo najbližšie k hladine, aby olej čo najmenej špliechal. (Prípadne dvoma lyžicami namočenými v horúcom oleji naberieme na prvú lyžicu zhruba 1 PL cesta, druhou lyžicou ho jemne vytvarujeme do guľata a opatrne spustíme do horúceho oleja.) Rýchlo opakujeme, kým nie je wok plný, ale nie preplnený. Puff-puff vyprážame a počas vyprážania ich obraciame sieťkou alebo dierovanou lyžicou, kým nie sú nafúknuté a zo všetkých strán zlatistohnedé, asi 6 minút. Puff-puff preložíme na pripravený plech.

4. Olej znova rozohrejeme na 165 °C a vyprážame zvyšné cesto, ďalej po dávkach. Puff-puff preložíme do servírovacej misy a podávame horúce, teplé alebo pri izbovej teplote. Puff-puff môžeme jesť samotné, obalené v korenenom cukre alebo s dipom.

en.v: instead of frying as in the method below, the dish can be made in the air fryer.

Steps:
1. Make and prove the batter as in steps 1–2. Brush small silicone moulds (e.g. a mini-muffin mould) with oil.
2. Fill each mould with 1 tbsp of batter, spray the tops lightly with oil and air-fry until puffed and golden, 8–10 minutes.
3. Unmould and serve as in step 4. The result is closer to soft little buns than to crisp fried puff-puff.

⅓ čerstvej čili papričky habanero alebo Scotch bonnet, bez stopky
1 ČL (3 g) hrubozrnná soľ Diamond Crystal (pri jemnej soli dáme objemovo polovicu, hmotnostne rovnako)

en.t: 1. In a medium bowl, cover peas with 5 cm cold water. Let soak at room temperature for at least 15 minutes and up to 1 hour (this short soaking time helps loosen the skins without overly softening the peas).

2. Drain soaked peas, then transfer to a countertop blender or food processor along with 945 ml water. Pulse to slightly break up peas, about ten 1-second pulses. Pour into a medium bowl and let stand at room temperature for up to 30 minutes (skins will float to top as they separate from the peas).

3. Set a colander over a large bowl. Slowly pour soaking water into the colander while using a free hand to keep the peas in the soaking bowl; the goal is to pour off as many of the floating skins as possible while leaving the peas behind. Pick out any peas that landed in the colander and return them to the bowl, then discard skins and soaking water. Cover peas with water, and repeat process until peas are nearly free of skins (you may need to gently massage the peas with your hands to separate any stubborn skins).

4. Transfer skinned peas to a clean colander, rinse under cool running water, then return to medium bowl. Add fresh water to cover and let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes (this will further soften the peas for blending).

5. Drain peas, then transfer to a countertop blender or food processor. Add 120 ml water, onion, chile pepper, and salt. Blend, scraping down sides occasionally with a flexible spatula, until a smooth, thick paste has formed, about 3 minutes. Transfer paste to a medium bowl and whisk until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.

6. Line a rimmed baking sheet with paper towels. In a wok or Dutch oven, heat 5 cm of oil over medium-high heat to 175 °C. Dip a heatproof spoon into the hot oil, scoop up roughly 1 tbsp (15 ml) of batter, then carefully lower spoonful of batter into oil until batter is submerged and releases from spoon. It can be formed into a little football shape by molding the batter as it slides off the side of the spoon into the hot oil (rather than allowing the batter to spread as it slides off the spoon). Working quickly, repeat the process with 7 more scoops of batter (for a batch of 8). Fry, using a slotted spoon or spider to turn pieces halfway through, until akara are slightly puffed and golden brown on both sides, about 6 minutes. Transfer to prepared baking sheet to drain.
7. Return oil to 175 °C, and repeat with remaining batter. Serve fritters warm with soft white bread.

sk.t: 1. V strednej mise zalejeme hrach 5 cm studenej vody. Necháme namáčať pri izbovej teplote aspoň 15 minút a najviac 1 hodinu (toto krátke namáčanie pomôže uvoľniť šupky bez toho, aby hrach príliš zmäkol).

2. Namočený hrach scedíme a preložíme do stolového mixéra alebo kuchynského robota spolu s 945 ml vody. Pulzmi hrach mierne nalámeme, asi desiatimi 1-sekundovými pulzmi. Vylejeme do strednej misy a necháme postáť pri izbovej teplote najviac 30 minút (šupky sa pri oddeľovaní od hrachu vyplavia na povrch).

3. Nad veľkú misu položíme cedník. Vodu z namáčania pomaly vylievame do cedníka a voľnou rukou zadržiavame hrach v mise; cieľom je vyliať čo najviac plávajúcich šupiek a hrach nechať v mise. Hrach, ktorý sa dostal do cedníka, vyberieme a vrátime do misy, šupky a vodu vyhodíme. Hrach zalejeme vodou a postup opakujeme, kým hrach nie je takmer bez šupiek (tvrdohlavé šupky môžeme oddeliť jemným masírovaním hrachu rukami).

4. Olúpaný hrach preložíme do čistého cedníka, opláchneme studenou tečúcou vodou a vrátime do strednej misy. Zalejeme čerstvou vodou a necháme 10 minút postáť pri izbovej teplote (hrach tak ešte zmäkne a lepšie sa rozmixuje).

5. Hrach scedíme a preložíme do stolového mixéra alebo kuchynského robota. Pridáme 120 ml vody, cibuľu, čili papričku a soľ. Mixujeme a občas zoškrabujeme steny pružnou stierkou, kým nevznikne hladká, hustá pasta, asi 3 minúty. Pastu preložíme do strednej misy a šľaháme metličkou, kým nie je ľahká a nadýchaná, asi 3 minúty.

6. Plech s okrajom vystelieme papierovými utierkami. Vo woku alebo liatinovom hrnci rozohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni 5 cm oleja na 175 °C. Žiaruvzdornú lyžicu ponoríme do horúceho oleja, naberieme ňou zhruba 1 PL (15 ml) cesta a opatrne ju ponoríme do oleja, kým cesto nie je ponorené a neuvoľní sa z lyžice. Cesto môžeme vytvarovať do tvaru malej šišky, ak ho pri skĺzavaní z okraja lyžice do horúceho oleja tvarujeme (namiesto toho, aby sa pri skĺznutí z lyžice roztieklo). Rýchlo postup zopakujeme so 7 ďalšími lyžicami cesta (na dávku 8 kusov). Vyprážame a v polovici kúsky obrátime dierovanou lyžicou alebo sieťkou, kým akara nie sú mierne nafúknuté a z oboch strán zlatistohnedé, asi 6 minút. Preložíme na pripravený plech, aby odkvapkali.
7. Olej znova rozohrejeme na 175 °C a zopakujeme so zvyšným cestom. Placky podávame teplé s mäkkým bielym chlebom.

2. Drain soaked peas, then transfer to a countertop blender or food processor along with 945 ml water. Pulse to slightly break up peas, about ten 1-second pulses. Pour into a medium bowl and let stand at room temperature for up to 30 minutes (skins will float to top as they separate from the peas).

3. Set a colander over a large bowl. Slowly pour soaking water into the colander while using a free hand to keep the peas in the soaking bowl; the goal is to pour off as many of the floating skins as possible while leaving the peas behind. Pick out any peas that landed in the colander and return them to the bowl, then discard skins and soaking water. Cover peas with water, and repeat process until peas are nearly free of skins (you may need to gently massage the peas with your hands to separate any stubborn skins).

4. Transfer skinned peas to a clean colander, rinse under cool running water, then return to medium bowl. Add fresh water to cover and let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes (this will further soften the peas for blending).

5. Drain peas, then transfer to a countertop blender or food processor. Add 120 ml water, onion, chile pepper, and salt. Blend, scraping down sides occasionally with a flexible spatula, until a smooth, thick paste has formed, about 3 minutes. Transfer paste to a medium bowl and whisk until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.

6. Line a rimmed baking sheet with paper towels. In a wok or Dutch oven, heat 5 cm of oil over medium-high heat to 175 °C. Dip a heatproof spoon into the hot oil, scoop up roughly 1 tbsp (15 ml) of batter, then carefully lower spoonful of batter into oil until batter is submerged and releases from spoon. It can be formed into a little football shape by molding the batter as it slides off the side of the spoon into the hot oil (rather than allowing the batter to spread as it slides off the spoon). Working quickly, repeat the process with 7 more scoops of batter (for a batch of 8). Fry, using a slotted spoon or spider to turn pieces halfway through, until akara are slightly puffed and golden brown on both sides, about 6 minutes. Transfer to prepared baking sheet to drain.
7. Return oil to 175 °C, and repeat with remaining batter. Serve fritters warm with soft white bread.

1. V strednej mise zalejeme hrach 5 cm studenej vody. Necháme namáčať pri izbovej teplote aspoň 15 minút a najviac 1 hodinu (toto krátke namáčanie pomôže uvoľniť šupky bez toho, aby hrach príliš zmäkol).

2. Namočený hrach scedíme a preložíme do stolového mixéra alebo kuchynského robota spolu s 945 ml vody. Pulzmi hrach mierne nalámeme, asi desiatimi 1-sekundovými pulzmi. Vylejeme do strednej misy a necháme postáť pri izbovej teplote najviac 30 minút (šupky sa pri oddeľovaní od hrachu vyplavia na povrch).

3. Nad veľkú misu položíme cedník. Vodu z namáčania pomaly vylievame do cedníka a voľnou rukou zadržiavame hrach v mise; cieľom je vyliať čo najviac plávajúcich šupiek a hrach nechať v mise. Hrach, ktorý sa dostal do cedníka, vyberieme a vrátime do misy, šupky a vodu vyhodíme. Hrach zalejeme vodou a postup opakujeme, kým hrach nie je takmer bez šupiek (tvrdohlavé šupky môžeme oddeliť jemným masírovaním hrachu rukami).

4. Olúpaný hrach preložíme do čistého cedníka, opláchneme studenou tečúcou vodou a vrátime do strednej misy. Zalejeme čerstvou vodou a necháme 10 minút postáť pri izbovej teplote (hrach tak ešte zmäkne a lepšie sa rozmixuje).

5. Hrach scedíme a preložíme do stolového mixéra alebo kuchynského robota. Pridáme 120 ml vody, cibuľu, čili papričku a soľ. Mixujeme a občas zoškrabujeme steny pružnou stierkou, kým nevznikne hladká, hustá pasta, asi 3 minúty. Pastu preložíme do strednej misy a šľaháme metličkou, kým nie je ľahká a nadýchaná, asi 3 minúty.

6. Plech s okrajom vystelieme papierovými utierkami. Vo woku alebo liatinovom hrnci rozohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni 5 cm oleja na 175 °C. Žiaruvzdornú lyžicu ponoríme do horúceho oleja, naberieme ňou zhruba 1 PL (15 ml) cesta a opatrne ju ponoríme do oleja, kým cesto nie je ponorené a neuvoľní sa z lyžice. Cesto môžeme vytvarovať do tvaru malej šišky, ak ho pri skĺzavaní z okraja lyžice do horúceho oleja tvarujeme (namiesto toho, aby sa pri skĺznutí z lyžice roztieklo). Rýchlo postup zopakujeme so 7 ďalšími lyžicami cesta (na dávku 8 kusov). Vyprážame a v polovici kúsky obrátime dierovanou lyžicou alebo sieťkou, kým akara nie sú mierne nafúknuté a z oboch strán zlatistohnedé, asi 6 minút. Preložíme na pripravený plech, aby odkvapkali.
7. Olej znova rozohrejeme na 175 °C a zopakujeme so zvyšným cestom. Placky podávame teplé s mäkkým bielym chlebom.

sk.v: Pripravená plnka vydrží v chladničke až 2 dni.

en.t: 1 tbsp (15 ml) extra-virgin olive oil
1 large yellow onion (250 g), finely chopped ( chopped)
70 g finely chopped red bell pepper (from 1 small 200 g pepper)
70 g finely chopped green bell pepper (from 1 small 200 g pepper)
2 tbsp (10 g) finely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
1 tsp (5 ml) ground paprika
1 tsp (5 ml) ground cumin
1 tsp (5 ml) ground coriander
1/2 tsp (1.5 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt, or more to taste; for table salt use half as much by volume
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) ground cayenne pepper, if desired
170 g ground beef (15 to 20% fat)
16 sheets filo pastry (227 g)
240 ml frying oil such as canola or sunflower oil
3 tbsp (45 ml) mayonnaise
2 tbsp (30 ml) harissa paste
1 tbsp (15 ml) water

1. For the Filling: In a large saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat until shimmering. Add the onions, cover, and cook, stirring often, until onions are soft and translucent, 8 to 10 minutes. Uncover and cook, stirring occasionally, until all the liquid evaporates, 3 to 5 minutes longer.
2. Add red and green bell peppers, parsley, paprika, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, and cayenne (if using) and cook, stirring often, until peppers are soft, 8 to 10 minutes.

3. Add ground beef and cook over medium heat, breaking up the meat with a wooden spoon, until no longer pink and all the liquid has evaporated, 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl, then adjust seasoning, adding more salt if necessary. Cool filling to room temperature, about 30 minutes; alternatively, transfer filling to an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 2 days. Once filling has cooled to room temperature, strain the filling if you notice a large amount of pooled oil (this may not be necessary, unless the meat had a very high fat percentage).
4. Meanwhile, for the Sauce: Whisk together mayonnaise, harissa, and water in a small bowl until smooth and creamy. Set aside or refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 2 days.

5. To Assemble and Cook: Unroll the filo pastry sheets and, using a sharp knife, pizza wheel, or scissors, cut them into 15 × 28 cm strips. Cover filo strips with a damp towel until ready to use to prevent them from drying out.

6. Place one filo strip on a clean work surface, with the short side facing you. Fold it in half like a book, bringing the left edge to meet the right edge, to create a strip that is 7.5 × 28 cm. Place a heaping tbsp of filling (about 20 g) about 2.5 cm from the bottom of the strip towards the right side. Fold the left bottom corner of the filo strip over filling to tightly enclose and form a triangle. Continue folding the triangle, flipping right and then left until you reach the end of the strip. Use a sharp knife or scissors to trim any excess filo pastry. Place folded briouats seam-side down on a tray and cover loosely until ready to fry. Repeat with remaining filo strips and filling.

7. In a Dutch oven or high-sided skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat until oil reaches 180 °C on an instant-read thermometer. Working in batches, carefully transfer briouats to the oil, placing them folded side down. Fry briouats until the underside is golden, then flip the briouats over and continue frying until both sides are golden and crisp, about 2 to 3 minutes in total. Use a slotted spoon or tongs to transfer briouats to a paper towel-lined plate. Repeat until all the briouats are fried.
8. Serve briouats immediately with sauce.

1. Plnka: vo veľkom hrnci zohrejeme na strednom ohni olivový olej, kým sa nezačne vlniť. Pridáme cibuľu, prikryjeme a za častého miešania dusíme, kým cibuľa nie je mäkká a sklovitá, 8 až 10 minút. Odkryjeme a za občasného miešania varíme, kým sa všetka tekutina neodparí, ešte 3 až 5 minút.

2. Pridáme červenú a zelenú papriku, petržlenovú vňať, sladkú papriku, mletú rascu (kmín), mletý koriander, soľ a kajenské korenie (ak ho používame) a za častého miešania dusíme, kým papriky nezmäknú, 8 až 10 minút.

3. Pridáme mleté hovädzie mäso a na strednom ohni ho opekáme, pričom ho drevenou varechou rozdrobujeme, kým nie je ružové a všetka tekutina sa neodparí, 3 až 5 minút. Preložíme do misy a dochutíme, podľa potreby dosolíme. Plnku necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu, asi 30 minút; prípadne ju preložíme do uzavretej nádoby a uchovávame v chladničke až 2 dni. Keď plnka vychladne na izbovú teplotu, scedíme ju, ak si všimneme veľa nazbieraného oleja (nemusí to byť potrebné, iba ak malo mäso veľmi vysoký podiel tuku).
4. Medzitým omáčka: v malej miske vymiešame metličkou majonézu, harissu a vodu dohladka a do krémova. Odložíme alebo uchovávame v uzavretej nádobe v chladničke až 2 dni.

5. Skladanie a vyprážanie: pláty cesta filo rozvinieme a ostrým nožom, radielkom na pizzu alebo nožnicami ich nakrájame na pásy s rozmermi 15 × 28 cm. Pásy filo prikryjeme vlhkou utierkou, kým ich nepoužijeme, aby nevyschli.

6. Jeden pás filo položíme na čistú pracovnú plochu kratšou stranou k sebe. Preložíme ho na polovicu ako knihu, ľavý okraj k pravému, aby vznikol pás s rozmermi 7,5 × 28 cm. Vrchovatú polievkovú lyžicu plnky (asi 20 g) položíme asi 2,5 cm od spodného okraja pásu, bližšie k pravej strane. Ľavý dolný roh pásu preložíme cez plnku, aby sme ju pevne uzavreli a vytvorili trojuholník. Trojuholník ďalej prekladáme striedavo doprava a doľava, až kým nedôjdeme na koniec pásu. Ostrým nožom alebo nožnicami odrežeme prebytočné cesto filo. Poskladané briouaty položíme spojom nadol na podnos a do vyprážania ich voľne prikryjeme. Zopakujeme so zvyšnými pásmi filo a plnkou.

7. V liatinovom hrnci alebo panvici s vysokými okrajmi rozohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni olej, kým na vpichovom teplomere nedosiahne 180 °C. Po dávkach opatrne vkladáme briouaty do oleja preloženou stranou nadol. Vyprážame, kým spodná strana nie je zlatistá, potom briouaty obrátime a vyprážame ďalej, kým nie sú z oboch strán zlatisté a chrumkavé, spolu asi 2 až 3 minúty. Dierovanou lyžicou alebo kliešťami ich preložíme na tanier vystlaný papierovými utierkami. Opakujeme, kým nevyprážime všetky briouaty.
8. Briouaty hneď podávame s omáčkou.

Lay sheets of foil in pan perpendicular to each other, with extra foil hanging over edges of pan. Push foil into corners and up sides of pan, smoothing foil flush to pan. Brush foil lightly with melted butter.

5. Lay 1 phyllo sheet on clean counter with short side parallel to edge of counter. Brush lightly with melted butter. Place second phyllo sheet directly over first sheet and brush lightly with melted butter. Repeat layering with 2 more phyllo sheets and melted butter. (You will have 4 layers total.)
6. Transfer phyllo stack to prepared pan. Ease dough into pan by gently lifting edge of dough with your hand while pressing into pan bottom with your other hand, letting excess dough hang over edge.

7. Repeat step 5. Place second phyllo stack in pan, perpendicular to first phyllo stack. Ease dough into pan by gently lifting edge of dough with your hand while pressing into pan bottom with your other hand, letting excess dough hang over edge.
8. Spread filling evenly over phyllo in pan.
9. Repeat step 5 two more times. Place phyllo stacks over filling, perpendicular to each other.

10. Pinch overhanging top and bottom layers of phyllo together firmly. Roll inward to create rope-like crust around tiropita; brush all over with melted butter. Using paring knife, score top phyllo stack into 9 equal pieces (2 cuts by 2 cuts), being sure to cut through rolled edges, but do not separate.

en.t: 30 g chopped raw walnuts
1 tbsp (15 ml) extra-virgin olive oil (15 g)
2 tbsp (30 ml) honey (30 g)
1 tsp (5 ml) freshly squeezed lemon juice, from about 1/4 of a lemon
1 tbsp (15 ml) chopped fresh parsley
2 tsp (10 ml) neutral oil, such as safflower or canola
One slab halloumi or kasseri cheese (140 to 170 g; about a 2.5 cm-thick slice)
55 g ouzo, tsipouro with anise, or arak; optional
Crusty bread or crackers, for serving

1. For the Walnut Vinaigrette: In a small saucepan, toast walnuts in olive oil over medium heat until nuts are golden brown and aromatic, about 4 minutes. Stir in honey and simmer until foamy, about 1 minute. Finish with lemon juice and parsley and set aside.

2. For the Cheese: In a small cast iron skillet, heat neutral oil over high heat until smoking, about 3 minutes. Add cheese and fry until golden brown, about 2 minutes, then flip, using a slotted offset spatula, to fry the other side. Remove from heat, leaving cheese in the pan.

3. To Flambé (optional): Pour alcohol into a small pot and warm over medium heat until steaming, about 1 minute. Turn off heat and, using a stick lighter, carefully light the fumes from the alcohol. Immediately pour the flaming alcohol over the cheese. (Use caution, as the fat in the pan will ignite in a glorious display.) Pour walnut vinaigrette on top to put out the flames. Serve right away alongside crusty bread or crackers.
4. To Serve Without Flambéing: Pour walnut vinaigrette directly over fried cheese. Serve right away alongside crusty bread or crackers.

en.t: 480 g King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
28 g King Arthur Better Cheddar Cheese Powder
113 g sour cream
4 tbsp (57 g) unsalted butter, softened
113 g water, warm
2 large eggs
2 tbsp (25 g) granulated sugar
1 1/2 tsp (9 g) table salt
2 tsp (6 g) instant yeast
1 tbsp (14 g) vegetable oil or olive oil
1 small peeled onion or shallot, finely diced; about 99 g
1 clove garlic, finely chopped
227 g ground beef
salt and pepper, to taste
chopped parsley, fresh or dried, to taste
170 g cheddar cheese, shredded
1 large egg, beaten with 1 tbsp (15 ml) water, to brush on dough
1. To make the dough: Weigh your flour. Combine all the dough ingredients and mix and knead — by hand, mixer, or bread machine — until a soft, smooth dough forms.
2. Transfer the dough to a lightly greased bowl, cover, and allow to rest for about 90 minutes, until puffy but not necessarily doubled in bulk.
3. To make the filling: Heat the oil in a sauté pan set over medium heat.
4. Add the onion and cook until translucent.
5. Add the garlic and ground beef and cook for 5 to 10 minutes, breaking the meat up as it browns, until it's cooked through.
6. Season the filling with salt, pepper, and parsley, remove it from the heat, and cool to room temperature.
7. Stir in the cheese. The filling can be made ahead of time, then wrapped and stored in the refrigerator until ready to use.
8. Divide the dough into 16 equal pieces; if you have a scale they'll weigh about 57 g each.
9. Shape the pieces into balls, and place them on lightly greased or parchment-lined baking sheets, leaving about 2.5 cm between them.
10. Cover the dough balls, and allow them to rest for about 15 minutes.

11. Shape each ball into a flattened round about 13 cm in diameter, brush the surface with some of the egg/water wash, and place 2 tbsp (30 ml) of filling onto the center of each round; a tbsp cookie scoop works well here.
12. Pull the dough over the filling, pinching two opposite edges together tightly, to seal in the filling; it should look like a dumpling.
13. Place the buns on two lightly greased or parchment-lined baking sheets. Cover the buns, and allow them to rise for 1 hour, or until puffy.
14. Towards the end of the rising time preheat the oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C).

15. Brush the buns with the remaining egg wash. Bake the buns for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden brown. It's OK if some of the seams have come undone and the filling is visible; they can be prettier that way!
16. Remove the buns from the oven and allow them to cool for 5 to 10 minutes before serving.
17. Store any leftover buns in the refrigerator.
